summary: Electric bass played with the fingers: round, warm, the default band bass
label: finger bass
body: The bass for anything played by a band: funk, soul, R&B, pop, rock, reggae (play it short and deep), disco (octaves).

Register: MIDI 28-52 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Finger Bass, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Finger Bass") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
